notes: Gravimetric (langasite crystal microbalance) H2 uptake on CVD-grown MWCNT forests, unprocessed and atomic-oxygen-irradiated (open-ended), at 40 °C up to 100 kPa (Figs. 6, 8, 10). MWCNT mass was estimated geometrically (8.4 x 10^-5 g). Pt, Ni and Fe films were also measured as references (not carbon). No specific surface area is reported for any sample: Section 3.2 only computes C atoms per gram from an assumed 3.8 x 10^19 C atoms/m2 for ideal graphene, which is not a reported surface area; the Introduction mentions 'enlarged surface area' only qualitatively. Not a review; not retracted (record and PDF); no duplicate-data statement.
